messages:
maria: quick design check — pushed a small update to the dark theme in Figma, link in thread. Primary goal: make the metric header text + tiny legend labels readable at 12px without blowing the visual weight. screenshot attached :point_down:

jamie: looked — main issue imo is panel bg vs header text. at 12px weight 500 it's slipping. can we try either increase to 13/14px or adjust text color to boost contrast? :thinking:

oliver: quick color pass — my suggestions for variables (devs can implement):
```css
:root {
  --bg: #07090b; /* page bg */
  --panel: #0e1214; /* panels */
  --surface: #0f1418; /* cards */
  --text-primary: #e8f0f6; /* main copy */
  --text-muted: #9fb0bd; /* small labels */
}
```
These keep overall tone and give ~7:1 text vs bg for primary and ~3.2:1 for muted on panel. but muted is borderline for 12px small labels.

kate: for syntax highlighting in console we should separate semantic roles more (strings vs functions vs constants). current green/blue pair is close for Deuteranopia. propose a trichromatic-safe set: strings #9ad29b, keywords #8fb6ff, funcs #ffd08f, comments #69737a. Also, can we use token outlines for inline code at small sizes? e.g., `span.token { text-shadow: 0 0 0.8px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }` to improve legibility without brightening color.

oliver: for charts — current line colors are too saturated next to dark grid. suggestions: use desaturated tints with distinct luminance steps: #6aa8ff, #7ad3b6, #ffc87a, #c58bff, #ff7b7b. also increase legend font-size to 13px and add 2px padding in legend boxes.

maria: noted — two trade-offs: maintain visual hierarchy (charts shouldn't yell) vs make per-series color distinguishable when printed small. can we run a quick palette v2 that keeps saturation low but increases relative hue distance?

a11y-bot: automated contrast scan results:
- --text-primary (#e8f0f6) vs --panel (#0e1214): 8.1:1 (PASS)
- --text-muted (#9fb0bd) vs --panel (#0e1214): 3.0:1 (FAIL for 4.5:1 small text)
- legend color #6aa8ff vs panel: 4.2:1 (PASS for larger labels, borderline for 12px)
- sparkline #ffc87a vs bg: 2.8:1 (FAIL)
Recommendation: bump muted to #bfcfd9 and sparkline to #ffd585 or add a 1px halo on dark bg.

maria: thanks bot — sounds like concrete steps: 1) bump muted to #bfcfd9 (check), 2) increase legend font to 13px, 3) desaturate + nudge hues for charts, 4) small token text-shadow fallback for inline code. can designers mock the palette v2 by EOD?

jamie: can do a quick figma pass tonight. also want to try an alternate: preserve muted color but add a 1px semi-opaque overlay (`mix-blend-mode: overlay` is flaky) — prefer explicit color change for consistency.

kate: on syntax — i'll upload a code example with new tokens and a11y variants (high/medium/low) so platform can switch via theme toggle.

maria: perfect. last ask: charts with many series — add a "colorblind mode" toggle that switches to a tested palette (oliver's hues above as default for that). also update copy for the toggle to "Color accessibility mode — improves distinction for color vision differences".

jamie: ack. i'll add a small note in the console settings doc and link to the rollout PR when done. :thumbsup:
